plan.comment: Plan by the member at the editor's word in this session, 16:2x: the talk is 90 minutes; a whole section on his work (SGit, the newsroom, PHP October, SHarness and booting Linux in the browser, the PKI and how agents communicate, the CLI), built from his existing content: screenshots of pages cropped and explained, with the title and the link, as ruv.sgit did; the researcher reads newsroom.sgit.ai, pki.sgit.ai, sharness.ai and the CLI's articles. 1) team/conductor/briefs/2026-10-29__editor/2-the-work-section-1630.md (his words, the section, who does what) and a short section in __onboarding-studio.md (studio@ takes the showcase slides). 2) Requests in mailroom/researcher, storyteller, deck, studio, dev; a notice to ruv-sgit (its SHarness series feeds the demo); vault_check first. 3) pace.json (the section, its owners, 90 minutes), status.json. AMENDED after the pre-review's change: both conditions go into the brief and every request: (1) no screenshot captures a key, a key's QR, a read key or anything private (pki.sgit.ai and the vault pages show keys: crop them out or skip them); (2) the Linux-in-the-browser demo has an offline fallback (a recorded clip or stills) for when the room's network fails.
